newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Fletcher sees no change to targeted FCL shrs.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Fletcher sees no change to targeted FCL shrs.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Ltd Chief Executive Hugh Fletcher said on Wednesday he did not envisage the group moving away from its targeted share structure in favour of individual companies, but would do so if it were in shareholders' interests.

"I don't see any reason why we would move from a targeted stock structure to individual companies. We are very satisfied that the targeted stock structure has no disadvantages and some advantages," Fletcher told the New Zealand Investment Conference.
FCL last year split its operations into three divisional stocks, on top of Fletcher Forests, which had aready been separated from the group.
The divisions now take the form of FCL Building, FCL Paper and FCL Energy.
Fletcher, in answer to a question, said that if a corporate were prepared to pay more for a company than a division, then the situation would change.
"If that is in the shareholders' interests, then that is what we would do," he said.
